title: Acknowledgments
paragraphs: _Bold Conjectures, Volume I: Select Interviews of David Deutsch_ would have been impossible without the enormous efforts of Randy True and Bert Arquelada, who created the cleaned transcriptions of the interviews in this volume. Randy is the founder of the education nonprofit Focus On Foundations (www.focusonfoundations.org).

David Kedmey, Cofounder of Conjecture Institute, has been advising me since this project began, and he was indispensable in helping to format the interviews that constitute it. I thank him for his almost daily doses of strategic and technical wisdom.
I thank all of the interviewers who graciously permitted me to include their interviews in this compendium.
And finally, thanks to David Deutsch for his numerous contributions to human thought and for allowing me to compile some of them into this book.
